# /fc:test

[← Back to commands](../commands.md)

<!-- Generated by skills/ai-layout/scripts/sync-docs.js from commands/test.md; do not edit. Edit docs/commands/_notes/test.md instead. -->

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Claude name | `/fc:test` |
| Codex name | `$fc-test` |
| Kind | Project task — loads `ai-factory/tasks/test.md` from your repo, so it needs an adopted workspace |
| Description | Write acceptance tests from the spec's acceptance criteria, independently of the implementation |
| Arguments | `<spec path> red\|gaps` |

## Usage

Run `/fc:test` with a spec path and a mode. The `tester` subagent writes acceptance tests from the
spec's acceptance criteria. It reads the spec, the plan and the project's existing tests, but only
the implementation's public surface, never the diff. A test derived from the implementation would
restate it instead of checking it.

- **`red`**, before implementing. The tests target the next plan step unless you ask for
  whole-plan coverage. They must fail, and fail for the documented missing behaviour.
  Failures that belong to future steps are grouped by test identity and expected cause.
- **`gaps`**, after the steps are done. It runs the relevant regressions and covers any criterion
  that ended up with no test.

It returns an AC → test table with the failure messages. It then says whether the red tests fail
for the right reason, or which criteria are still uncovered.

See also: [Feature workflow: Test red](../workflows/feature.md#6-test-red),
[Test gaps](../workflows/feature.md#8-test-gaps) and
[workflow.md §4](../../ai-factory/docs/workflow.md#4-the-main-loop).

## Examples

```
/fc:test ai-factory/specs/PMB-003-csv-export.md red
/fc:test ai-factory/specs/PMB-003-csv-export.md gaps
```

## Writes

- Test files only, never production code.
- With artifact contracts enabled, in `red` also the red evidence for the step the tests target,
  recorded with `make -f ai-factory/make/ai.mk verify DELIVERY=<id> STEP=S<N> PHASE=red`. In `gaps`
  it runs `make -f ai-factory/make/ai.mk contracts DELIVERY=<id>` and reports every artifact that is
  not valid.

## Refuses or asks

- With no argument, it asks which spec and which mode, `red` or `gaps`, and stops.
- It never touches production code. When a test needs a change there, it stops and says so.
- A failing test is a finding. It never weakens an assertion, adds a skip, loosens a matcher or
  deletes a case to reach green.
- A red test that passes before the code exists is treated as a broken test, not a success.
- When the repo has no `ai-factory/` workspace, it reports that it needs `/fc:adopt-sdlc`.
